svg.title: Plastic laminate partition door, edge view
svg.desc: A plastic laminate door cut through near its edge: a resin-impregnated particleboard core with high-pressure laminate bonded to both faces and an edge band covering the edge. 1 inch thick (Bobrick).
svg.text: Edge view: a door cut through near its edge. Faces and
edge not to scale. Thickness: Bobrick DesignerSeries HPL.
Schematic: shows the principle, not one manufacturer's product.
